summary: Decision memory specializes the maintenance rules for durable shared memory to architectural decisions.

items.text: Apply indexing, recall transparency, staleness review and explicit supersession to ADR-based memory.
See Agent Pipelines & Triggered Roles for the related use case or counterpoint: Treat the agent workflow as a pipeline. Roles join at defined points or on triggers — not ad-hoc.
See Context Compaction & JIT Retrieval for the related use case or counterpoint: Less context, retrieved on demand, beats more context dumped upfront.

See Continuous Two-Way Alignment for the related use case or counterpoint: Continuously reconcile system artifacts and their human-facing companion in both directions so neither machine progress nor human knowledge becomes an isolated, drifting truth.
See Council: Review Verdicts Need a Reaction for the related use case or counterpoint: Every named review finding gets an accountable decision: fix, accept with reasons, or escalate.

See Sidecar Metadata for the related use case or counterpoint: Put rich artifact metadata in predictably named companion files beside the artifact so people and agents can see, diff and discover it without opening the content.

See Topic Switching in One Long Operator Context for the related use case or counterpoint: Keep a session warm while shared context saves orientation time; reset it when repair density shows that old topics have become interference.
